question: Before ~11:22 ET, does building the %R lines with today's premarket bars as warm-up (the operator's TradingView, ETH on) give better morning empty-square entries than the desk's current warm-up on the previous session's last RTH bars?
operator_sentence: Operator 2026-10-27: 'Preregister a historical test: morning square entries with the slow line warmed up on premarket (chart-style) vs the previous afternoon (current desk), same controls as the pitch studies.'
registered_at: 2026-10-27 evening ET, before any premarket data is fetched or any script is written.
origin: Operator chart check 10/27: same indicator settings as the desk (fast 21/EMA 7, slow 112/EMA 3, close), but ETH on. IONQ 10:07 SIP slow line: chart -35.7, premarket warm-up rebuild -36.2, desk-style rebuild -28.3; under the chart's line IONQ was not in the square and the desk's buy there lost -$2.42. HOOD 12:59 and ENPH 14:03 were identical under both warm-ups. One example, chosen because it lost; it motivates the test and is not evidence.
prior: Most %R timing variants have been ~random against controls (pitch studies 10/27, %R trend trade). A different warm-up mostly moves the slow line by a few points before 11:22, so the expected difference is small: 0 +- 3 bp per trade.

definitions.lines: Desk lines copied from tools/studies/pitch_open.py: fast Williams %R(21) then EMA span 7, slow %R(112) then EMA span 3, pandas ewm(adjust=False); 2-15 minute in-session gaps flat-filled (live grid); a zero range carries the EMA (as live).
definitions.warmup_RTH: CURRENT DESK: the previous session's RTH bars, then today's RTH bars from 09:30.
definitions.warmup_ETH: CHART: today's premarket bars 04:00-09:29 ET (as they exist; 2-15 minute gaps flat-filled, longer gaps not filled, the same grid rule), then today's RTH bars. If today has fewer than 112 premarket+RTH bars at minute t, the previous session's RTH bars are prepended until 112 are available (TradingView would read the previous session's after-hours bars there; the warehouse has none, declared).
definitions.empty_square_onset: pitch_open.empty_square exactly (fast >= -35 and slow >= -35 and |fast-slow| <= 15, not both >= -20, fast(t) > fast(t-1) + 0.05), onset = true at t and false at t-1, 15-minute refractory per name per warm-up (pitch_open onset rules).
definitions.window: Signal minute t in 09:45..11:22 ET (585..682), the span where the 112-bar slow window still reaches before 09:30. Minutes after 11:22 are identical under both warm-ups and are not scored.
definitions.universe: Warehouse names (prior-day liquidity rule) with today's first RTH SIP open in [$20, $150] (the live price floor era), that have both IEX and SIP premarket bar files for the day.
definitions.populations: ETH = onsets under warmup_ETH; RTH = onsets under warmup_RTH. A name-minute may be in both. Classes for information: BOTH (same name, onsets within +-2 minutes), RTH_ONLY (the desk would buy, the chart would not), ETH_ONLY (the chart would buy, the desk would not).

feeds.primary: IEX lines (what the desk computes live; a switch would use IEX premarket bars).
feeds.information: SIP lines (the operator's chart replication). No pass of its own.

entry_exit_cost: pitch_open exactly: entry SIP open of t+1 (> 0, else skipped and counted), exit SIP close of entry+9 (HOLD 10), gross = close/open - 1. Grade cost 10 bp round trip for net (pitch-study grade); 3 and 5 bp printed as information. The primary is a difference of two populations, where a flat cost cancels.
controls: pitch_open exactly (wr_trend_trade.seeded, tags ew-d, ew-d2, ew-x, ew-x2, entry_min = t+1): d = same name, a minute c in entry+1..entry+60 with SIP open(c) > 0, close(c+9) > 0, c+9 < 960; x = another SIP symbol that day (the day's sorted SIP file) with open(entry) > 0 and close(entry+9) > 0.

statistic.primary: DELTA = per day, mean gross of the ETH population minus mean gross of the RTH population (days where both populations have >= 1 scored trade); day-equal mean, t = mean / (stdev / sqrt(n_days)) (eod_reversal.stats).
statistic.secondary_required: For the ETH population: day-equal lift_d and lift_x (gross minus control gross), each > 0 in both halves. A warm-up that only looks better than the desk's but still loses to a random minute is not a reason to switch.
statistic.information: Class counts and day-equal gross / lifts for BOTH, RTH_ONLY, ETH_ONLY; net at 3/5/10 bp; the RTH population's own lifts; SIP-line versions of everything.

data.sessions: The 120 warehouse sessions 2026-04-27..2026-10-15 plus the 70 warehouse_confirm sessions 2026-01-14..2026-04-24 (RTH bars already on the mini). No study has ever scored a premarket warm-up on these days.
data.fetch: New: premarket 1-minute bars 04:00-09:29 ET, IEX and SIP, split-adjusted, for the universe names on each session, via the data-only key (as tools/studies/warehouse_fetch.py), written only when every chunk succeeds, to ai_reports/warehouse_pm/{iex,sip}/<day>.npz. Run after hours and never while replays or the nightly run on the mini (Alpaca budget).
data.halves: By count over scored sessions in date order: half A the older ceil(N/2), half B the newer.

power.count_step: Before any mean: sessions, onsets per population and class, skips by reason, and MDE = 3.08 x stdev(day means of [ETH-population control_d - RTH-population control_d]) / sqrt(n_days) per half (controls only, outcome-blind). No gross, lift or net is printed.
power.floors: Per half: >= 40 days with both populations, >= 300 trades in each population, MDE <= 5 bp. If a floor fails, UNDERPOWERED and no means are printed.

pass: BOTH halves: DELTA >= +3 bp with t >= 2.0; ETH lift_d > 0 and lift_x > 0; and for DELTA, dropping its 3 best days leaves it >= 0 and dropping the 5 symbols with the largest DELTA contribution leaves it >= 0.
fail: DELTA <= 0 in either half is FAIL regardless of t. Anything else short of PASS is FAIL (or UNDERPOWERED under the floors).
if_pass: result-skeptic Mode 3 review, then a separate live prereg for switching the desk's warm-up to premarket IEX bars (the desk would fetch them at the open).
if_fail: Keep the desk's warm-up. Record that the morning chart/desk disagreement is real but does not change entry quality, so the operator's chart and the desk will keep disagreeing before ~11:22.
canary: Synthetic tests first: both warm-ups produce identical lines once 112 RTH bars exist; a premarket gap of > 15 minutes is not filled; the onset/refractory rules; next-open entry; a +10 bp lift copy moves DELTA by +10 when added to the ETH population only. On the rows: --canary adds 10 bp to every ETH-population gross in a copy and prints only the change in DELTA per half (each within 1e-9 of +10 bp). --score refuses without canary_ok on the same module and prereg sha.
score_gate: --score refuses unless --skeptic-ready equals the 'ready' review id recorded in this file.
no_retuning: No other window, warm-up length, square threshold or hold is scored as primary.
script: tools/studies/eth_warmup.py and the premarket fetcher, written after this file is committed and after a result-skeptic READY; they may not change anything above.
multiplicity: One primary (IEX). SIP and every class cell are information.

closed.why: Moot: the live desk already builds its %R lines from a 112-minute clock window that includes premarket (skeptic r1 finding 1; ai_entry_watch.live_exhaustion_pair). Never run.
